title: A listing within the limits, privacy answers from the code, and the launch-readiness check

runs.name: launch-ready
runs.cmd: cd shoreline && cp shoreline-crew/.env.example shoreline-crew/.env.local && cd shoreline-crew && git init -q -b main && git add -A && git commit -q -m "Lesson 9.4" && cd .. && git -C shoreline-crew remote add origin https://github.com/your-github-username/shoreline-crew.git && node ../launch_check.mjs
expect: READY for Session 25: the final project
